"\n\nOn hearing about the signing <TeamName2> fans spoke out ""Why would a player do that? We were doing so well it just makes no sense for him to leave right now."" Their manager added to the disbelief by stating ""It's silly! I mean can I understand why he left though. The wage he was offered would be very tempting to any player at his level. But I guess we have to move on. We're a team and we will continue to play as we have been playing all season."" <PlayerName> will be closely followed by the media in the weeks to come but <TeamName1>'s manager is confident he will play well for his new club. ""Nothing to worry about he's the same player now as he was when he was at <TeamName2>. Mark my words he will be a big star."" "

"<FullPlayerName> has handed in a transfer request and is set to leave <TeamName> after reportedly being unsettled for a while.\n<ManagerName>, confirmed the news fans had long dreaded when speaking to the assembled media at the club's training ground.\n<ManagerName> said: ""It has been a poorly-kept secret for a while that <PlayerName> wasn't happy here, and so it is with the best interests of the player and the club that we have accepted his transfer request. We'll now work as quickly as possible to bring the matter to a swift conclusion. There will be no further comment on this matter from the club or from me. I have a full squad of players to worry about and cannot involve myself with players who don't want to be here."""

"\n\n<UserName> looked back on his first game in charge during a bizarre press conference. ""Losing the first game is always hard to swallow. I was hoping for a win or at least a draw but this is how football works. I know the players can pick themselves up from the defeat and I can also take many positive aspects away from the match in hindsight. One of them being thankful the scoreline wasn't larger!"" However will the fans appreciate his humour with not long left until the next match? ""I don't think we should have lost that match and I don't think the manager should have made a joke about the scoreline. However it is early days yet we hope the lads can do us proud"" were the words of an enthusiastic <TeamName> supporter."
